same_content.instructions: The text under `translation` renders the same passage as the text under `original` (same content, not a different passage of the same work).

coverage.instructions: How much of `original` does `translation` cover? Judge the extent of content overlap, not literary quality.

criteria.whole: the translation covers the whole original
criteria.partial: the translation covers only part of the original
criteria.more: the translation contains substantially more than the original
criteria.not_translation: the translation is not a translation of this original

identical_text.instructions: The text under `translation` is identical (or near-verbatim identical) to the text under `original` -- i.e. no actual translation happened.

is_english.instructions: The text under `translation` is written in English.

is_french.instructions: The text under `translation` is written in French.
